ingredients.name: Leafgill
ingredients.description: A cabbage-finned fish that folds its leaves when startled. Give the line slack when it struggles; its layers turn buttery in a pan.

ingredients.name: Pepperbell
ingredients.description: Rattling orange pods hide a warm, peppery seed. Harvest once a day, then cultivate its seeds in your garden.

ingredients.name: Brothback stock
ingredients.description: This kettle-shelled creature vents steam before charging. Step aside and collect the stock it sheds while cooling.

ingredients.name: Lanternroot
ingredients.description: A luminous tuber sheltered beneath dark trees. The tender root becomes sweet when simmered. It can be grown at home.

ingredients.name: Cloudfruit
ingredients.description: Buoyant fruit floats above the mistwood canopy. Gather gently from its low branches. Botanical gloves let you take a larger harvest. Whisk it into an airy dessert.

ingredients.name: Harbor grain
ingredients.description: The harbor keeps a small free grain allowance. Three portions are restored each morning so a hungry kitchen can always recover.

recipes.name: Pepperbell Leaf Wrap
recipes.description: Warm seeds tucked in a cabbage-fish leaf.

recipes.name: Harbor Porridge
recipes.description: A simple, comforting way to keep the doors open.

recipes.name: Steamstone Broth
recipes.description: A deep spring stock with toasted Pepperbell.

recipes.name: Lanternroot Congee
recipes.description: A glowing bowl for the long way home.

recipes.name: Cloudfruit Soufflé
recipes.description: A little island sky, served warm.

upgrades.name: Forager's satchel
upgrades.description: Carry eight additional ingredients on each outing.

upgrades.name: A bigger table
upgrades.description: Restore the terrace and welcome five guests each evening.

upgrades.name: Hire Nori
upgrades.description: Nori delivers cooked dishes, leaving you free to work at the stove. Requires a restored terrace.

upgrades.name: Expedition provision locker
upgrades.description: Carry four additional ingredients. The ferry is already free.

upgrades.name: Botanical gloves
upgrades.description: Gather three Cloudfruit instead of two from each tree.
